scam.label: Reading the message for warning signs

scam.finding: It asks for $2,000 in gift cards. Real jails and lawyers never ask for gift cards.
It says "don't tell mom". Scammers ask for secrecy so no one can warn you.
It pushes you to act right now, which leaves no time to check.

scam.label: Searching the web: “grandson in jail gift cards scam”

scam.finding: The FTC warns about this exact trick, called the "grandparent scam".

scam.label: Searching the web: “how to report grandparent scam FTC”

scam.finding: You can report it for free at reportfraud.ftc.gov.

verdict.headline: This is a scam. Do not buy any gift cards.
reasons: It asks for gift cards. Real jails, police, and lawyers never take gift cards.
It asks you to keep it a secret, which is a classic scam trick.
This matches the "grandparent scam" the FTC warns about.
nextSteps: Do not reply and do not buy gift cards.
Call your grandson on the number you already have for him.
Tell a family member you trust about this message.

signals: No signs of AI were found. Text alone cannot be checked by a machine.
